source.title: Collection of Object-Centric Event Logs (SAP IDES O2C and P2P)

serial_latency.aggregation: pooled p50/p95 with retained per-epoch p50/p95/min/max and epoch p95 median/range
serial_latency.raw_evidence: positive integer nanosecond samples and realized randomized arm-order codes

method.latency_scope: database extraction/aggregation plus model construction and scoring
method.baseline: indexed relational OCEL in vanilla PostgreSQL plus independent Python reference kernels
method.candidate: pg_ocpm compact aggregates plus ocpm-engine Rust kernels
method.correctness_gate: canonical result equality before latency inclusion
method.execution_order: randomized per measured pair with recorded seed

concurrency.connection_model: prestarted thread workers with one persistent PostgreSQL connection per worker; connection setup and pool startup excluded
concurrency.warmup_gate: one exact canonical warmup response from every worker
concurrency.correctness_gate: exact canonical equality for every measured request
concurrency.aggregation: median epoch QPS and median epoch p50/p95/p99; every epoch retained
concurrency.arm_order: deterministic rotation by worker level and epoch

method.storage: sum of PostgreSQL heap, index, and TOAST relation bytes
